system.special: <p><strong><p><strong>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Animal Form: </strong> </strong> &lt;/strong&gt; In animal form, a lycanthrope can be harmed only by magical weapons, silvered weapons, or spells. It cannot speak normal languages, but can speak with normal animals of its weretype. Human Form: In human form a lycanthrope often looks somewhat like its wereform. It can speak and use weapons normally. Summon Animals: Any lycanthrope can summon 1d2 normal animals of its type; they arrive in 1d4 rounds. Wolfsbane: If hit by wolfsbane, the lycanthrope must save vs. poison or flee in fear.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Surprise: 1-4 on 1d6.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Human Form AC: 9.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/p&gt;</p></p>
system.description: Weretigers are relatives of the great cats: curious, dangerous when threatened, and quiet trackers that surprise on 1-4 on 1d6. They are good swimmers and summon local great cats, preferring tigers. In human form their AC is 9.
